integrity: The source dates were checked against the first public arXiv submission. The theorem is established by an explicit integral Mayer–Vietoris spectral-sequence proof and low-dimensional homotopy argument, with limited finite checks recorded separately. No independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three disjoint filled simplices, tolerance two, each vertex block cardinality at least two. Ordinary integral homotopy only; no equivariant homotopy, general chordal graph or other tolerance parameter claimed. Independent mathematical review and complete publication-priority verification are not performed.
title: Two-tolerance complexes of three disjoint simplices: a uniform integral sphere-wedge formula
